task: W03 bounded review of the current root-authored artwork export package
scope: Independent review of the current root-route provenance records, 40 raster exports, mechanical export recipe and receipts, route-conditional asset schema, delivered asset manifest, specimen and asset-board pages, parent-generation reuse validation, and the press index publication gate. No source, master, export, manifest, registry, script, or page was edited by this reviewer.

asset_registry.registry_status: planned for all 72 rows by package design

route_authorization.review_boundary: The user authorization permits the registered root image-tool route. It does not attest a named model or backend, create a native child agent, clear rights, approve publication, or turn generated artwork into product or gameplay evidence.

mechanical_integrity.procedure: Parse the current index, generation records, tool observations, recipe, receipts, manifest, and authorization; hash every indexed source and prompt; decode every source and raster export with Pillow; check declared source bytes, dimensions, mode, alpha, crop bounds, crop aspect tolerance, output dimensions, output format, receipt hashes and bytes, manifest export hashes and lineage IDs, and exact inline generation-record bodies.

targeted_reproducibility.procedure: Copy the current exporter, its art_policy dependency and generation policy into a temporary root; filter a temporary recipe and index to the four changed WEB-01 and WEB-03 rows; replay the exporter; compare temporary receipts, output hashes, output bytes, and dimensions to the current worktree.

exporter_negative_cases.procedure: Replay temporary recipes with parent traversal in source and output paths and with invalid WebP settings.
exporter_negative_cases.observed_error: ValueError: Unsafe provenance path. / ValueError: Invalid WebP encoding settings

schema_route.procedure: Validate all 72 manifest entries with Draft202012Validator and the local art-generation schema reference; mutate a valid root entry to use the legacy origin, omit its root route while retaining root origin, and use the Astra route with root origin.

parent_lineage.procedure: Run the 42 art-policy, press-gate, and asset-status tests; additionally copy current BG-01 and WEB-01 entries into an isolated two-asset fixture, mark only that fixture verified, and run validate_assets.verify so WEB-01 must reuse the exact BG-01 generation record.

visual_review.procedure: View four temporary 5-by-2 contact sheets covering all 40 raster exports, then inspect the current WEB-01 desktop/mobile WebPs, WEB-03 path-watch/path-build PNGs, ID-08 specimen PNG, and representative identity, background, poster, conceptual-map, and run-template exports with view_image.
observations: The current WEB-01 desktop and mobile crops retain a broad quiet left field and the abstract composition without visible lossy damage that affects the intended layout.

The current WEB-03 crops are clean 800x500 panels with complete icons, arrows, and lower labels. The source headings Watch and Build are outside the revised crops and must be supplied as adjacent visible and accessible surface text.
The identity, background, poster, conceptual-map, and blank run-template exports show no obvious clipping or accidental evidence claim in the sweep.
Generated report/poster and conceptual route artwork retain report-only, synthetic, or template boundaries where applicable; no generated visual was treated as gameplay evidence.
limits: A contact-sheet sweep is a bounded visual check, not a complete legal, rights, accessibility, or consuming-surface approval.
The WEB-03 exports are conditional on adjacent Watch and Build headings and equivalent accessible text.

interaction.example_feedback: Control activated. No account, network request, or publication action was involved.

findings.required_follow_up: Rename the prompt files to the required .md paths and update every index, observation, generation record, manifest reference, and hash, or make a deliberate policy amendment that explicitly accepts .txt and rerun the route checks. Keep the release gate closed until one choice is consistently recorded.

findings.required_follow_up: Update the root-route directory fields to the actual canonical layout, or add an explicit documented indirection and make every consumer follow it. Re-run package and provenance checks after the update.
